title: Needs ability to save queries with templates
body: This is getting very close to convincing me to purchase. In fact, to take this to the next level, I'd love to see some feature to allow template values to be entered with favorites (aka snippets on other tools). Mobile usage is quite different for me than desktop. When I'm mobile there's often a need to do emergency checks where I may need to type certain values in to a query. To have the ability to select a query and then be asked for something like an Id number that gets passed into the query would make this a must have OnCall support tool for me and well worth the $39.99 p/y cost.
